'''GE-31''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] it was stationed on the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
GE-31 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation and begins one-time opening and closing cutscenes for the Republic faction.<ref name="SWTOR" />
